rawContent: Five years ago, at @journalismfest, I moderated a panel on #MeToo in #journalism, as well as a panel on #moralinjury. The experience convinced me to share my own #mentalhealth and assault story for @Poynter https://t.co/QLtRVeo0ar

I hope one day we really can find a way to believe survivors and hold perpetrators to account. I say this even more fervently as a journalist, knowing that our role is to hold powerful to account but knowing too that our industry needs to do a lot more work in its backyard #metoo
